narrative:
Henry County has 18,940 registered voters, with 50.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 37.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 11.9%, a pronounced Republican lean of 25.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.3% of registrants.
